network_object: Corr(epsilon_i, epsilon_j), after leave-one-out market removal
economic_meaning: Pairwise association after removing broad contemporaneous market co-movement.
data_evidence: Market removal reduces the positive average correlation by 0.987–0.991; mean residual correlation is only 0.003–0.004.
industry_structure: Strongly preserved. Residual Same-Cross gap is 0.085–0.089; Residual Top-1% industry enrichment is 4.881–7.083.

high_dimensional_feasibility: High. Market residualization and pairwise correlation scale well to the full universe; sparsification is still required.
main_advantage: Removes the dominant market-wide common component while preserving economically meaningful industry structure.
main_limitation: Still a marginal pairwise association measure; it does not establish conditional independence given all other stocks.

network_candidate: Sparse Conditional Association on Market Residuals
network_object: -Omega_ij / sqrt(Omega_ii Omega_jj), estimated with sparse high-dimensional methods
economic_meaning: Direct conditional association after controlling for the remaining stock system.
data_evidence: NOT YET ESTIMATED at full-market scale. Step 6 demonstrates substantial residual structure worth testing conditionally.
industry_structure: Unknown until full-market sparse precision estimation is performed.

main_limitation: Tuning, sparsity assumptions, computation, and network stability require formal validation.
